subject: Canot deploy app after deleting earlier version from shiny apps.io

messages.author: cb361d4d765593e5
messages.subject: Canot deploy app after deleting earlier version from shiny apps.io
parts:
I am trying to deploy an app after I deleted an older version of the app from shinyapps.io.

In the beginning, it used to work well without any problems. However, since I deleted an older version of the app from shinyapps.io, I cannot deploy any more recent versions. I get the following error message:


> rsconnect::deployApp()

Preparing to deploy application...

Error: HTTP 404
GET https://api.shinyapps.io/v1/applications/217483
Not Found


I think it might try to update the older version but fails to find it, because it no longer exists. Any help on how to resolve this?

Many thanks!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Canot deploy app after deleting earlier version from shiny apps.io
parts:
In your project directory, there is a sub-directory "rsconnect/shinyapps.io" that then contains a directory with your account name, which contains a DCF file with the application name.

This file stores the application id of the application. If you delete the application via the dashboard, you need to remove this file so that a new application will be created with a new id.
